title: Bring Things & Bring Along
situation: Preparing tools and equipment before the shift starts.
objective: Use bring things and bring along to talk about carrying what you need at work.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Before my shift, I bring things that I need for the day.
dialogue.indonesian: Sebelum shift, saya membawa barang-barang yang saya butuhkan untuk hari ini.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I bring my tools, my notebook, and my radio.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya membawa alat, buku catatan, dan radio saya.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: My supervisor asks me to bring along the test bag to the work area.
dialogue.indonesian: Supervisor saya meminta saya membawa tas uji ke area kerja.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I also bring along a spare cable because we may need it later.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya juga membawa kabel cadangan karena mungkin dibutuhkan nanti.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: It is easier when I bring things in one small bag.
dialogue.indonesian: Lebih mudah jika saya membawa barang-barang dalam satu tas kecil.

learningNotes: bring things memakai bentuk jamak karena barangnya lebih dari satu.
bring along berarti membawa sesuatu atau seseorang bersama kita.
bring adalah kata kerja yang tidak berubah: I bring, he brings.
